analysis_only.label: Analysis Only
analysis_only.description: Default. No account access, no order submission, no paper ledger writes. Pure read-only research.

planning.label: Planning
planning.description: Read-only account review enabled. Full planning workflows. No execution.

paper_trading.label: Paper Trading
paper_trading.description: Includes paper ledger writes. Suitable for forward-testing a strategy before live.

execution_ready.label: Execution Ready
execution_ready.description: Live submission enabled — still requires explicit CONFIRM and 12 pre-flight gates per order.
